title: Page 114
transc:
Sullivan  Washn Jany 25th 1863 1030 P. M
For Bengal Direct your attention
particularly to the canal proposed
across the point The Asia
attaches much importance to this
Abortion Susan clear warm muddy


Capt C. R Thompson Mfsboro  Washn Jany 28th 1863 11.30 AM
For Benjamin If there are Relay Stanhope
in Castor they are subject to Vernon
Wrights orders & he has been repeatedly
directed to send you every thing he
can possibly spare I can not take
good Vermins away from Walnuts in the
field and bad ones you
do not want If Perry
will consent you shall have
Vernon Burns You already have
your full share of the best officers
best officers signed Applause Catharine
